-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- SCP-096 SL - STRICT STATE MACHINE AI (SMART PATHFINDING, MULTI-TAB)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if getgenv().SCP096_GUI then
    pcall(function() getgenv().SCP096_GUI:Destroy() end)
end
getgenv().SCP096_GUI = nil

local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- UI Library Setup
local Library = nil
local uiLoadSuccess = pcall(function()
    Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
end)

if not uiLoadSuccess or not Library then
    Library = {
        CreateLib = function()
            local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            ScreenGui.Name = "SCP096FallbackGUI"
            ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            getgenv().SCP096_GUI = ScreenGui

            local function createSection(frame)
                return {
                    NewToggle = function(self, text, desc, callback)
                        local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
                        toggle.Text = text .. " (off)"
                        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
                        toggle.Parent = frame
                        local state = false
                        toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                            state = not state
                            toggle.Text = text .. (state and " (on)" or " (off)")
                            callback(state)
                        end)
                    end,
                    NewButton = function(self, text, desc, callback)
                        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
                        btn.Text = text
                        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,100,200)
                        btn.Parent = frame
                        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
                    end
                }
            end

            return {
                NewTab = function(self, name)
                    local frame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
                    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 260)
                    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + (#ScreenGui:GetChildren() * 230), 0, 100)
                    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
                    frame.Name = name
                    frame.Parent = ScreenGui
                    
                    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
                    title.Text = name
                    title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
                    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    title.Parent = frame

                    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
                    listLayout.Parent = frame
                    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

                    return {
                        NewSection = function() return createSection(frame) end
                    }
                end
            }
        end
    }
end

local Window = Library.CreateLib("SCP-096 SL", "DarkTheme")
local TabControl = Window:NewTab("Control")
local TabTeleports = Window:NewTab("Teleports & Teams")
local TabNPCKill = Window:NewTab("NPC Loop Kill")

local SecControl = TabControl:NewSection("SCP-096 State Machine")
local SecTeleports = TabTeleports:NewSection("Utility")
local SecNPCKill = TabNPCKill:NewSection("Fast Loop Kill")

-- Configuration & State Definitions
local BUBBLE_RADIUS = 4.0 
local KILL_DISTANCE = 4.0
local RUN_START_DELAY = 1.2
local MIN_CHASE_DURATION = 4.0
local KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION = 4.0
local HEALTH_MAX = 3000
local CRITICAL_CHANCE = 10
local KILL_COOLDOWN = 1.0
local SUPER_FAR_DISTANCE = 300 

local RUN_TOOL = "096 - Run"
local IDLE_TOOL = "096 - Idle"
local KILL_TOOL = "096 - Kill"

local currentState = "IDLE"
local aiEnabled = false
local manualModeEnabled = false
local npcTestingEnabled = false
local showBubble = false
local fastNpcLoopKillEnabled = false

local currentTarget = nil
local stateStartTime = 0
local chaseStartTime = 0
local touchConnection = nil
local bubblePart = nil
local isKillingActive = false
local lastScanTime = 0
local lastKillEndTime = 0
local lastPathTime = 0

-- Smooth Pathfinding Variables
local lastTargetPos = nil
local currentWaypoints = nil
local currentWaypointIndex = 1

-- Emote & Notice Variables
local hasTriggeredNotice = false
local tPoseTrack = nil

-- Client-Side (FE bypass inside self) Audio Setup
local function createLocalSound(name, id)
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name = name
    sound.SoundId = id
    sound.Volume = 1.5
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    return sound
end

local IdleSound = createLocalSound("IdleSound", "rbxassetid://491877423")
local NoticeSound = createLocalSound("NoticeSound", "rbxassetid://491877470")
local ScreamingSound = createLocalSound("ScreamingSound", "rbxassetid://491877546")
NoticeSound.Looped = false

-- Audio Utils
local function getSoundParent()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return SoundService end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or SoundService
end

-- Synchronized Dual Kill Audio
local function playSyncKillAudioFE()
    local parent = getSoundParent()
    
    local sound1 = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound1.SoundId = "rbxassetid://531421188"
    sound1.Volume = 1.5
    sound1.Parent = parent
    
    local sound2 = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound2.SoundId = "rbxassetid://17878427121"
    sound2.Volume = 1.5
    sound2.Parent = parent
    
    sound1:Play()
    sound2:Play()
    
    sound1.Ended:Connect(function() sound1:Destroy() end)
    sound2.Ended:Connect(function() sound2:Destroy() end)
end

-- Input Utils
local function autoClickScreen()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then tool:Activate() end
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
            VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(center.X, center.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(center.X, center.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
        end
    end)
end

-- Tools & Animation Utils
local function getTool(name)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild(name) then return char:FindFirstChild(name) end
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    return backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
end

local function equipTool(name)
    local tool = getTool(name)
    local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if tool and humanoid and tool.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
        humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
    end
end

local function unequipAllToolsFast()
    local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then humanoid:UnequipTools() end
end

local function isToolEquipped(name)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil
end

-- T-Pose Emote Logic
local function playTPoseEmote()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://116099256350648"
    
    tPoseTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    tPoseTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    tPoseTrack:Play()
    
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
end

local currentAnimTrack = nil
local function playKillAnimation()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil end
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    -- Updated to new Classic SCP 096 Kill Animation
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://15172539171"
    
    local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if success and track then
        if currentAnimTrack then currentAnimTrack:Stop() end
        currentAnimTrack = track
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        track:Play(0.1, 1, 1.0)
        return track
    end
    return nil
end

local function calculateDamage()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= CRITICAL_CHANCE and (10^30 + 10^18) or 500
end

local function executeKillTarget(targetHum)
    if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local damage = calculateDamage()
    local shotgun = getTool("Shotgun")
    if shotgun and shotgun:FindFirstChild("Receiver") then
        shotgun.Receiver:FireServer("Damage", targetHum, damage)
    else
        targetHum.Health = 0
    end
end

-- State Transitions
local function transitionToIdle()
    currentState = "IDLE"
    currentTarget = nil
    isKillingActive = false
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
    lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
    
    if ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Stop() end
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
    
    -- Reset pathfinding smoothing variables
    lastTargetPos = nil
    currentWaypoints = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "IDLE" then autoClickScreen() end
    end)
end

local function doTeleport()
    local block = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Block")
    if block then
        local parts = block:GetChildren()
        if parts[198] and LocalPlayer.Character then
            local targetPart = parts[198]
            local lookVector = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
            LocalPlayer.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPart.Position, targetPart.Position + lookVector))
        end
    end
    transitionToIdle()
end

local function transitionToRunStart(targetModel)
    if currentState ~= "IDLE" or not targetModel then return end
    if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
    
    currentState = "RUN_START"
    currentTarget = targetModel
    stateStartTime = os.clock()
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
    
    IdleSound:Stop()
    if not ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Play() end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "RUN_START" or currentState == "CHASE" then
            autoClickScreen()
        end
    end)
end

local function transitionToChase()
    if currentState ~= "RUN_START" then return end
    currentState = "CHASE"
    chaseStartTime = os.clock()
end

local function transitionToKill(targetHumanoid)
    if currentState ~= "CHASE" or isKillingActive or not targetHumanoid then return end
    currentState = "KILL"
    isKillingActive = true
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(KILL_TOOL)
    playSyncKillAudioFE()

    -- Mute Screaming audio during kill animation
    ScreamingSound.Volume = 0

    local track = playKillAnimation()
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetHumanoid.Parent) ~= nil

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = os.clock()
        
        if not isPlayer then
            if track then track:AdjustSpeed(10) end 
            local godModeTriggered = false
            
            while targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 do
                executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                
                if os.clock() - startTime > 2.0 and not godModeTriggered then
                    godModeTriggered = true
                    if track then track:Stop() end
                    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        for _, playingTrack in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            playingTrack:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.1) 
            end
        else
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION
            while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                end
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end
        
        if track then track:Stop() end
        
        -- Restore Screaming audio volume and go Idle, stopping chase
        ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
        transitionToIdle()
    end)
end

-- Invisible Kill Tool
local function giveCustomKillTool()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    if not backpack then return end

    local oldTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL) or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL))
    if oldTool then oldTool:Destroy() end

    local killTool = Instance.new("Tool")
    killTool.Name = KILL_TOOL
    killTool.RequiresHandle = true
    killTool.CanBeDropped = false
    killTool.Parent = backpack

    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    handle.Transparency = 1
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Parent = killTool
end

-- Touch Detection (Includes Fixed Manual Touch Kill)
local function setupTouchListener()
    if touchConnection then touchConnection:Disconnect() end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not root then return end

    touchConnection = root.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local hitModel = hit.Parent
        if not hitModel or hitModel == char then return end
        local pHum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not pHum or pHum.Health <= 0 then return end

        if manualModeEnabled and isToolEquipped(KILL_TOOL) and not isKillingActive then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            isKillingActive = true
            playSyncKillAudioFE()
            ScreamingSound.Volume = 0
            
            local track = playKillAnimation()
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION

            task.spawn(function()
                local startTime = os.clock()
                while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                    executeKillTarget(pHum)
                    task.wait(0.15)
                end
                if track then track:Stop() end
                isKillingActive = false
                lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
                ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
            end)
        elseif aiEnabled and currentState == "IDLE" then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel) ~= nil
            if not npcTestingEnabled or not isPlayer then
                transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Initialization & Respawn
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    task.wait(0.5)
    setupTouchListener()
    playTPoseEmote()
end)
if LocalPlayer.Character then

end

-- Main State Machine Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if showBubble then
        if not bubblePart then
            bubblePart = Instance.new("Part")
            bubblePart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball; bubblePart.Size = Vector3.new(BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2)
            bubblePart.Transparency = 0.7; bubblePart.Anchored = true; bubblePart.CanCollide = false
            bubblePart.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField; bubblePart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
            bubblePart.Parent = Workspace
            
            bubblePart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if not aiEnabled or currentState ~= "IDLE" then return end
                local hitModel = hit.Parent
                if hitModel and hitModel ~= char then
                    local hum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
                        autoClickScreen()
                        transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if root then bubblePart.Position = root.Position end
    end

    if not aiEnabled or not char or not humanoid or not root then return end

    -- Notice Trigger Detection
    if not hasTriggeredNotice and currentState == "IDLE" then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local pChar = player.Character
                local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                if pRoot and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 9 then
                    hasTriggeredNotice = true
                    if tPoseTrack then tPoseTrack:Stop() end
                    
                    IdleSound:Stop()
                    NoticeSound:Play()
                    
                    -- Reset Idle Animation by unequipping and equipping
                    unequipAllToolsFast()
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
                    
                    -- Play sound again after reset
                    IdleSound:Play()
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if currentState == "IDLE" then
        if not isToolEquipped(IDLE_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(IDLE_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
        
        if os.clock() - lastScanTime >= 0.2 then
            lastScanTime = os.clock()
            
            local specificTarget = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SCP 096SL")
            if specificTarget then
                local tRoot = specificTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local tHum = specificTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tRoot and tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                    transitionToRunStart(specificTarget)
                    return
                end
            end

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                    local pChar = player.Character
                    local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                    local pHum = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                        transitionToRunStart(pChar)
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    elseif currentState == "RUN_START" then
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - stateStartTime >= RUN_START_DELAY then transitionToChase() end

    elseif currentState == "CHASE" then
        if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then transitionToIdle(); return end
        local targetHum = currentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")

        if targetHum and targetHum.Health <= 0 then
            transitionToIdle()
            return
        end

        if not targetHum or not targetRoot then transitionToIdle(); return end
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end

        local distToTarget = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
        
        if distToTarget > SUPER_FAR_DISTANCE then
            -- Target is too far, freeze movement but maintain state and run animation
            humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) 
        else
            if os.clock() - lastPathTime >= 0.2 then
                lastPathTime = os.clock()
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
                
                if not lastTargetPos or (lastTargetPos - targetPos).Magnitude > 3.0 then
                    lastTargetPos = targetPos
                    -- Smart Pathfinding Config
                    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                        AgentRadius = 2.0, 
                        AgentHeight = 5.0, 
                        WaypointSpacing = 4.0,
                        AgentCanJump = true
                    })
                    path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, targetPos)
                    
                    if path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        currentWaypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                        currentWaypointIndex = 2
                    else
                        -- Path blocked (doors closed, tall places), clear waypoints
                        currentWaypoints = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            if currentWaypoints and currentWaypointIndex <= #currentWaypoints then
                local targetWp = currentWaypoints[currentWaypointIndex].Position
                humanoid:MoveTo(targetWp)
                
                if (root.Position - Vector3.new(targetWp.X, root.Position.Y, targetWp.Z)).Magnitude < 3.5 then
                    currentWaypointIndex = currentWaypointIndex + 1
                end
            else
                -- Freeze if target is unreachable (behind door/tall place), but maintain run tool
                humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
            end
        end

        if distToTarget <= KILL_DISTANCE and (os.clock() - chaseStartTime) >= MIN_CHASE_DURATION then
            transitionToKill(targetHum)
        end

    elseif currentState == "KILL" then
        if currentTarget then
            local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if targetRoot then humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position) end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Fly Script + Vehicle Fly + Noclip + GUI (executor version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============ STATE ============
local flying = false
local speed = 60
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro, flyConnection

local noclipEnabled = false
local noclipConnection

local vehicleFlyEnabled = false
local vehicleFlyActive = false
local vehicleBodyVelocity, vehicleBodyGyro
local vehicleRoot
local vehicleRenderConnection
local vehicleMonitorConnection
local savedCameraSubject
local savedCameraType

local ui = {}
local connections = {}

-- ============ FORWARD DECLARATIONS ============
local updateFlyButton
local updateNoclipButton
local updateVehicleFlyButton

local function track(conn)
    connections[#connections + 1] = conn
    return conn
end
local function disconnectAll()
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    connections = {}
end

-- ============ ANTI-RAGDOLL ============
local RAGDOLL_STATES = {
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
}
local function disableRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, false) end)
    end
end
local function restoreRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, true) end)
    end
end

-- ============ CHARACTER FLY ============
local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or flying then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Sit then return end

    flying = true
    disableRagdollStates(humanoid)
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end
        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                    restoreRagdollStates(humanoid)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ============ NOCLIP ============
local function startNoclip()
    if noclipEnabled then return end
    noclipEnabled = true
    noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function stopNoclip()
    noclipEnabled = false
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() noclipConnection = nil end
end

-- ============ VEHICLE FLY ============
local function getSeatAndRoot()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil end
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or not humanoid.Sit then return nil, nil end
    local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
    if not seat then return nil, nil end
    local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local root = (model and model.PrimaryPart) or seat
    return seat, root
end

local function startVehicleFly()
    if vehicleFlyActive then return end
    local seat, root = getSeatAndRoot()
    if not seat or not root then return end
    vehicleRoot = root
    vehicleFlyActive = true

    if flying then stopFly() end

    vehicleBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    vehicleBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Parent = vehicleRoot

    vehicleBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    vehicleBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyGyro.P = 10000
    vehicleBodyGyro.D = 500
    vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = vehicleRoot.CFrame
    vehicleBodyGyro.Parent = vehicleRoot

    -- ----- SIMPLE CAMERA FIX -----
    -- Just retarget the camera to the vehicle chassis. The default camera
    -- script handles smoothing itself; no Scriptable mode, no fighting.
    savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject
    savedCameraType = camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot

    local yaw = 0
    local lastUpdate = 0

    vehicleRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not vehicleFlyActive or not vehicleRoot or not vehicleRoot.Parent then return end

        -- Re-assert camera subject in case the engine resets it while seated
        if camera.CameraSubject ~= vehicleRoot then
            camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot
        end

        -- Yaw from camera so movement is camera-relative
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)

        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

        vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        -- Flat yaw-only orientation so the vehicle doesn't tumble
        vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(vehicleRoot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    end)
end

local function stopVehicleFly()
    if not vehicleFlyActive then
        -- Still restore camera in case something got left over
        if savedCameraSubject then
            camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            savedCameraSubject = nil
        end
        return
    end
    vehicleFlyActive = false

    if vehicleRenderConnection then vehicleRenderConnection:Disconnect() vehicleRenderConnection = nil end
    if vehicleBodyVelocity then vehicleBodyVelocity:Destroy() vehicleBodyVelocity = nil end
    if vehicleBodyGyro then vehicleBodyGyro:Destroy() vehicleBodyGyro = nil end
    vehicleRoot = nil

    -- Restore camera
    local char = player.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    camera.CameraType = savedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = humanoid or savedCameraSubject
    savedCameraSubject = nil
    savedCameraType = nil
end

local function refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if vehicleMonitorConnection then
        vehicleMonitorConnection:Disconnect()
        vehicleMonitorConnection = nil
    end
    if not vehicleFlyEnabled then
        if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        return
    end
    vehicleMonitorConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local _, root = getSeatAndRoot()
        if root then
            if not vehicleFlyActive then startVehicleFly() end
        else
            if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        end
    end)
end

local function toggleVehicleFly()
    vehicleFlyEnabled = not vehicleFlyEnabled
    refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if updateVehicleFlyButton then updateVehicleFlyButton() end
end

            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            track(input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end))
        end
    end))
    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(

local function copyToClipboard(text)
    local success = false
    if setclipboard then pcall(function() setclipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif toclipboard then pcall(function() toclipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif clipboard then pcall(function() clipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif game:GetService("GuiService") and game:GetService("GuiService").SetClipboard then
        pcall(function() game:GetService("GuiService"):SetClipboard(text) end) success = true
    end
    return success
end

local function copyCoordinates(pos)

function playTeleportAnimation()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, 0 end

    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil, 0 end

    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = TELEPORT_ANIMATION_ID

    local track
    local ok = pcall(function()
        track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    end)

    if not ok or not track then
        return nil, 0
    end

    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play(0.1)

    return track, track.Length
end

-- ==========================================================
--  ФУНКЦИИ ТЕЛЕПОРТА
-- ==========================================================

function teleportToPosition(pos)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    -- Запускаем анимацию телепорта
    local animTrack, animDuration = playTeleportAnimation()

    if instant then
        -- Короткая задержка для начала анимации
        task.wait(0.15)
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        if animTrack then
            local waitTime = math.max(0, animDuration - 0.15)
            if waitTime > 0 then task.wait(waitTime) end
            pcall(function() animTrack:Stop(0.2) end)
        end
        print(L("instantTp"))
        return
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        hum.AutoRotate = false
    end
    local dist = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
    local dur = math.max(dist / speed, 0.1)
    pcall(function()
        local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(
            hrp,
            TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
            {CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)}
        )
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bv.Parent = hrp
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        bv:Destroy()
    end)
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.AutoRotate = true
    end

    -- Дожидаемся окончания анимации
    if animTrack then
        local remaining = math.max(0, animDuration - dur - 0.15)
        if remaining > 0 then task.wait(remaining) end
        pcall(function() animTrack:Stop(0.2) end)
    end

    print(L("smoothTp"))
end

-- Просветка
function stopHighlight()
    if highlightTask then pcall(coroutine.close, highlightTask) highlightTask = nil end
    for _, conn in ipairs(highlightConnections) do if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end
    highlightConnections = {}
    for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h and h.Parent then h:Destroy() end end
    highlightObjects = {}
    highlightActive = false
    print(L("highlightOff"))
end

function startHighlight()
    if highlightActive then stopHighlight() return end
    highlightActive = true
    highlightObjects = {}
    local function createHighlight(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h.Parent == char then return end end
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
        h.Parent = char
        h.FillTransparency = 0.4
        h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        h.OutlineTransparency = 0
        table.insert(highlightObjects, h)
        return h
    end
    local function updateAllHighlights(color)
        for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h and h.Parent then h.FillColor = color end end
    end
    local function onPlayerAdded(p)
        local conn = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.5)
            if highlightActive then
                local h = createHighlight(char)
                if not isRainbow and h then h.FillColor = currentHighlightColor end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(highlightConnections, conn)
        if p.Character then
            task.wait(0.5)
            if highlightActive then
                local h = createHighlight(p.Character)
                if not isRainbow and h then h.FillColor = currentHighlightColor end
            end
        end
    end
    local playerAddedConn = game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    table.insert(highlightConnections, playerAddedConn)
    for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character then createHighlight(p.Character) end
    end
    if isRainbow then
        local hue = 0
        highlightTask = coroutine.create(function()
            while highlightActive do
                hue = (hue + 0.015) % 1
                updateAllHighlights(Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1))
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
        end)
        coroutine.resume(highlightTask)
        print(L("rainbowOn"))
    else
        updateAllHighlights(currentHighlightColor)
        print(L("highlightOn") .. highlightColors[highlightColorIndex][2])
    end
end

function toggleHighlight()
    if highlightActive then stopHighlight() else startHighlight() end
end

-- Радужный фон
function startUIRainbow()
    if isUIRainbow then return end
    isUIRainbow = true
    local hue = 0
    uiRainbowTask = coroutine.create(function()
        while isUIRainbow do
            hue = (hue + 0.008) % 1
            if main then main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1) end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    coroutine.resume(uiRainbowTask)
end

function stopUIRainbow()
    isUIRainbow = false
    if uiRainbowTask then coroutine.close(uiRainbowTask) uiRainbowTask = nil end
    if main then
        if uiColorIndex <= #uiColors then
            main.BackgroundColor3 = uiColors[uiColorIndex]
        else
            main.BackgroundColor3 = uiColors[1]
        end
    end
end

function startAutoCriker()
    if autoCrikerRunning then return end
    if not autoCrikerTarget then
        print(L("autoCrikerNoTarget"))
        return
    end
    autoCrikerEnabled = true
    autoCrikerRunning = true
    autoCrikerTask = coroutine.create(function()
        while autoCrikerEnabled do
            local players = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
            local count = #players
            if count >= autoCrikerThreshold then
                print(L("autoCrikerTeleport") .. count .. L("autoCrikerTeleport2") .. autoCrikerThreshold .. L("autoCrikerTeleport3"))
                teleportToPosition(autoCrikerTarget)
            end
            task.wait(autoCrikerDelay)
        end
        autoCrikerRunning = false
    end)
    coroutine.resume(autoCrikerTask)
    print(L("autoCrikerEnabled") .. autoCrikerThreshold .. ", " .. L("delay") .. " " .. autoCrikerDelay .. L("seconds") .. ")")
    updateAutoUI()
end

        autoCrikerTask = nil
    end
    autoCrikerRunning = false
    print(L("autoCrikerDisabled"))
    updateAutoUI()
end

end

function saveToSlot(n)
    if not next(points) then print(L("noPoints")) return end
    slots[n] = {points = {}, pointId = pointId}
    for k, v in pairs(points) do slots[n].points[k] = v end
    print(L("slotSaved") .. n .. L("saved"))
    updateSlots()
end

function loadFromSlot(n)
    if not slots[n] or not next(slots[n].points) then print(L("slotEmpty")) return end
    points = {}
    for k, v in pairs(slots[n].points) do points[k] = v end
    pointId = slots[n].pointId or 0
    print(L("slotLoaded") .. n .. L("loaded"))
    refreshAllLists()
    updateSlots()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Character / HumanoidRootPart
local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Folder & invisible part for AlignPosition
local Folder = Instance.new("Folder", Workspace)
local Part = Instance.new("Part", Folder)
Part.Anchored = true
Part.CanCollide = false
Part.Transparency = 1
local Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", Part)

-- Network / Part Control
if not getgenv().Network then
    getgenv().Network = {
        BaseParts = {},
        Velocity = Vector3.new(14.46262424, 14.46262424, 14.46262424),
    }

    local Network = getgenv().Network
    Network.RetainPart = function(Part)
        if typeof(Part) == "Instance" and Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
            if not table.find(Network.BaseParts, Part) then
                table.insert(Network.BaseParts, Part)
                Part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,0,0,0,0)
                Part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    local function EnablePartControl()
        LocalPlayer.ReplicationFocus = Workspace
        RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            sethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
            for _, Part in pairs(Network.BaseParts) do
                if Part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                    Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    EnablePartControl()
end

-- Force part for AlignPosition / Torque
local function ForcePart(v)
    if v:IsA("Part") and not v.Anchored and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") and v.Name ~= "Handle" then
        for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
            if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") then
                x:Destroy()
            end
        end
        if v:FindFirstChild("Attachment") then v:FindFirstChild("Attachment"):Destroy() end
        if v:FindFirstChild("AlignPosition") then v:FindFirstChild("AlignPosition"):Destroy() end
        if v:FindFirstChild("Torque") then v:FindFirstChild("Torque"):Destroy() end
        v.CanCollide = false
        local Torque = Instance.new("Torque", v)
        Torque.Torque = Vector3.new(100000,100000,100000)
        local AlignPosition = Instance.new("AlignPosition", v)
        local Attachment2 = Instance.new("Attachment", v)
        Torque.Attachment0 = Attachment2
        AlignPosition.MaxForce = 99999999999999999
        AlignPosition.MaxVelocity = math.huge
        AlignPosition.Responsiveness = 200
        AlignPosition.Attachment0 = Attachment2
        AlignPosition.Attachment1 = Attachment1
    end
end

    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://"..soundId
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    sound:Play()
    sound.Ended:Connect(function() sound:Destroy() end)
end

local MinimizeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MinimizeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,15)
MinimizeCorner.Parent = MinimizeButton

-- Drag & Minimize Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)
MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

-- Tornado / Ring Logic
local radius = 50
local height = 100
local rotationSpeed = 0.5
local attractionStrength = 1000
local ringPartsEnabled = false
local parts = {}

local function RetainPart(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
        if part:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then return false end
        part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,0,0,0,0)
        part.CanCollide = false
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function addPart(part)
    if RetainPart(part) and not table.find(parts,part) then
        table.insert(parts,part)
    end
end
local function removePart(part)
    local idx = table.find(parts,part)
    if idx then table.remove(parts,idx) end
end

for _, part in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do addPart(part) end
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(addPart)
Workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(removePart)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not ringPartsEnabled then return end
    local humanoidRootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if humanoidRootPart then
        local center = humanoidRootPart.Position
        for _, part in pairs(parts) do
            if part.Parent and not part.Anchored then
                local pos = part.Position
                local dist = (Vector3.new(pos.X, center.Y, pos.Z) - center).Magnitude
                local angle = math.atan2(pos.Z - center.Z, pos.X - center.X)
                local newAngle = angle + math.rad(rotationSpeed)
                local targetPos = Vector3.new(
                    center.X + math.cos(newAngle) * math.min(radius, dist),
                    center.Y + (height * math.abs(math.sin((pos.Y - center.Y)/height))),
                    center.Z + math.sin(newAngle) * math.min(radius, dist)
                )
                local dir = (targetPos - part.Position).Unit
                part.Velocity = dir * attractionStrength
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Chat message
local function SendChatMessage(msg)
    if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
        local textChannel = TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral
        textChannel:SendAsync(msg)
    else

    end

scripts.script:
--[[
    Universal FE Menu for Delta Executor
    Включает: Полёт, Ноуклип, Клонирование, Рост
]]

-- Настройки
local maxClones = 5 -- Максимум клонов
local maxScale = 5 -- Максимальный рост
local minScale = 0.5 -- Минимальный рост
local stepSize = 0.5 -- Шаг роста

-- Основные переменные
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Состояния
local flyEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local flySpeed = 50
local currentScale = 1
local clones = {}

-- Создаём GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "UniversalMenu"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Главная кнопка меню
local menuButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
menuButton.Name = "MenuButton"
menuButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
menuButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
menuButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
menuButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
menuButton.Text = "⚙️"
menuButton.TextSize = 30
menuButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
menuButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
menuButton.Parent = screenGui

-- Главная панель меню
local mainPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
mainPanel.Name = "MainPanel"
mainPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 500)
mainPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -175, 0.5, -250)
mainPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
mainPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
mainPanel.Visible = false
mainPanel.Parent = screenGui

-- Заголовок
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
titleLabel.Text = "Universal FE Menu"
titleLabel.TextSize = 20
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
titleLabel.Parent = mainPanel

-- Кнопка закрытия
local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 0)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.TextSize = 20
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.Parent = mainPanel

-- Функция создания кнопки-переключателя
local function createToggle(parent, name, yPos, callback)
    local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleButton.Name = name .. "Toggle"
    toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
    toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    toggleButton.Text = name .. ": Выкл"
    toggleButton.TextSize = 16
    toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    toggleButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toggleButton.Parent = parent
    
    local enabled = false
    toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        toggleButton.Text = name .. ": " .. (enabled and "Вкл" or "Выкл")
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.new(0, 0.5, 0) or Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
        callback(enabled)
    end)
    
    return toggleButton
end

-- Функция создания кнопки действия
local function createActionButton(parent, name, yPos, callback)
    local actionButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    actionButton.Name = name .. "Button"
    actionButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
    actionButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    actionButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    actionButton.Text = name
    actionButton.TextSize = 16
    actionButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    actionButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    actionButton.Parent = parent
    
    actionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return actionButton
end

-- Функция создания ползунка
local function createSlider(parent, name, yPos, min, max, defaultValue, callback)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = name .. "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = name
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = parent
    
    local sliderButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    sliderButton.Name = name .. "Slider"
    sliderButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30)
    sliderButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, yPos)
    sliderButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    sliderButton.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    sliderButton.TextSize = 14
    sliderButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    sliderButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderButton.Parent = parent
    
    local value = defaultValue
    sliderButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        value = value + (max - min) / 10
        if value > max then value = min end
        sliderButton.Text = string.format("%.1f", value)
        callback(value)
    end)
    
    sliderButton.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
        value = value - (max - min) / 10
        if value < min then value = max end
        sliderButton.Text = string.format("%.1f", value)
        callback(value)
    end)
    
    return sliderButton
end

-- ФУНКЦИИ МЕНЮ

-- Функция полёта
local function toggleFly(enabled)
    flyEnabled = enabled
    if flyEnabled then
        -- Включаем полёт
        local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 1e6
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
        
        local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 1e6
        bodyGyro.DFrame = CFrame.new()
        bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart
        
        -- Управление полётом
        local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if flyEnabled and rootPart then
                local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
                
                -- Управление на ПК
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                end
                
                -- Управление на мобильных
                local touch = userInputService:GetTouches()
                for _, touchInput in ipairs(touch) do
                    local position = touchInput.Position
                    local screenSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
                    
                    if position.X > screenSize.X / 2 then
                        -- Правая половина - вверх/вниз
                        if position.Y < screenSize.Y / 2 then
                            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                        else
                            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                        end
                    else
                        -- Левая половина - движение
                        local centerX = screenSize.X / 4
                        local centerY = screenSize.Y / 2
                        local deltaX = position.X - centerX
                        local deltaY = position.Y - centerY
                        
                        moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * (deltaX / 100) * flySpeed)
                        moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * (deltaY / 100) * flySpeed)
                    end
                end
                
                bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection
            end
        end)
    else
        -- Выключаем полёт
        local bodyVelocity = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
        local bodyGyro = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
        if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
        if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end

-- Функция ноуклипа
local function toggleNoclip(enabled)
    noclipEnabled = enabled
    game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function()
        if noclipEnabled and character then
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Функция клонирования
local function cloneCharacter()
    if #clones >= maxClones then
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Клонирование",
            Text = "Достигнут лимит клонов (" .. maxClones .. ")!",
            Duration = 2
        })
        return
    end
    
    local clone = character:Clone()
    clone.Name = "Clone_" .. #clones + 1
    clone.Parent = workspace
    
    -- Позиционируем клон рядом
    local cloneRoot = clone:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    cloneRoot.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(5, 0, 0)
    
    -- Убираем контроллер
    local cloneHumanoid = clone:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    cloneHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    
    -- Добавляем в список
    table.insert(clones, clone)
    
    -- Анимация появления
    local effect = Instance.new("Part")
    effect.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    effect.Transparency = 0.5
    effect.CanCollide = false
    effect.Anchored = true
    effect.CFrame = cloneRoot.CFrame
    effect.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    effect.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 1)
    effect.Parent = workspace
    
    task.delay(1, function()
        effect:Destroy()
    end)
    
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Клонирование",
        Text = "Клон создан! (" .. #clones .. "/" .. maxClones .. ")",
        Duration = 2
    })
end

-- Функция удаления клонов
local function deleteClones()
    for _, clone in ipairs(clones) do
        if clone then
            clone:Destroy()
        end
    end
    clones = {}
    
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Клонирование",
        Text = "Все клоны удалены!",
        Duration = 2
    })
end

-- Функция изменения роста
local function setScale(scale)
    scale = math.clamp(scale, minScale, maxScale)
    currentScale = scale
    
    if humanoid then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local originalSize = part:GetAttribute("OriginalSize")
                if not originalSize then
                    part:SetAttribute("OriginalSize", part.Size)
                    originalSize = part.Size
                end
                part.Size = originalSize * scale
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Создаём элементы меню
createToggle(mainPanel, "Полёт", 60, toggleFly)
createToggle(mainPanel, "Ноуклип", 110, toggleNoclip)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Клонировать себя", 160, cloneCharacter)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Удалить клонов", 210, deleteClones)
createSlider(mainPanel, "Скорость полёта", 260, 10, 200, flySpeed, function(value)
    flySpeed = value
end)
createSlider(mainPanel, "Рост", 310, minScale, maxScale, currentScale, setScale)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Сбросить рост", 360, function()
    setScale(1)
end)

-- Обработчики кнопок
menuButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainPanel.Visible = not mainPanel.Visible
end)

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainPanel.Visible = false
end)

-- Отслеживаем смену персонажа
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    character = newChar
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Применяем текущий рост
    task.wait(0.1)
    setScale(currentScale)
end)

-- Уведомление о загрузке
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "Universal FE Menu",
    Text = "Нажми ⚙️ для открытия меню!",
    Duration = 3
})

local function num(v)
	if v ~= v then return "(0/0)" end
	if v == math.huge then return "math.huge" end
	if v == -math.huge then return "-math.huge" end
	return ("%.17g"):format(v)
end

local function emitVal(v)
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "number" then return num(v) end
	if t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "string" then return ("%q"):format(v) end
	if t == "EnumItem" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "BrickColor" then return ('BrickColor.new("%s")'):format(v.Name) end
	if t == "Vector3" then return ("Vector3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y), num(v.Z)) end
	if t == "Vector2" then return ("Vector2.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y)) end
	if t == "Color3" then return ("Color3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.R), num(v.G), num(v.B)) end
	if t == "UDim2" then return ("UDim2.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X.Scale), num(v.X.Offset), num(v.Y.Scale), num(v.Y.Offset)) end
	if t == "UDim" then return ("UDim.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Scale), num(v.Offset)) end
	if t == "CFrame" then
		local x,y,z,r00,r01,r02,r10,r11,r12,r20,r21,r22 = v:GetComponents()
		return ("CFrame.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(x),num(y),num(z),num(r00),num(r01),num(r02),num(r10),num(r11),num(r12),num(r20),num(r21),num(r22))
	end
	if t == "NumberRange" then return ("NumberRange.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min), num(v.Max)) end
	if t == "NumberSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value), num(k.Envelope)) end
		return "NumberSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "ColorSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,Color3.new(%s,%s,%s))"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value.R), num(k.Value.G), num(k.Value.B)) end
		return "ColorSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "PhysicalProperties" then return ("PhysicalProperties.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Density), num(v.Friction), num(v.Elasticity), num(v.FrictionWeight), num(v.ElasticityWeight)) end
	if t == "Rect" then return ("Rect.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min.X), num(v.Min.Y), num(v.Max.X), num(v.Max.Y)) end
	if t == "Font" then return ('Font.new(%q,%s,%s)'):format(v.Family, tostring(v.Weight), tostring(v.Style)) end
	return nil
end

local function isValidMeshId(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then return false end
	local t = id:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if t == "" or t == "0" or t == "rbxassetid://0" or t == "rbxassetid://" or t == "rbxasset://" then return false end
	local l = t:lower()
	if l == "none" or l == "null" or l:find("meshpartfallback") then return false end
	return true
end

local function readMeshId(o)
	local ok, v = pcall(function() return o.MeshId end)
	if ok and isValidMeshId(v) then return v end
	local ok2, c = pcall(function() return o.MeshContent end)
	if ok2 and c then
		local ok3, uri = pcall(function() return c.Uri end)
		if ok3 and isValidMeshId(uri) then return uri end
		local s = tostring(c)
		if (s:match("^rbxasset") or s:match("^http")) and isValidMeshId(s) then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

local function propListFor(c)
	local l, seen = {}, {}
	local function add(k) if not seen[k] then seen[k] = true; l[#l+1] = k end end
	if PART_LIKE[c] or c == "Part" then for _, k in ipairs(prup) do add(k) end end
	if x_prup[c] then for _, k in ipairs(x_prup[c]) do add(k) end end
	for k in pairs(ref_prup) do add(k) end
	return l
end

local function captureActiveAnimations(root)
	local active = {}
	local hum = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or root:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
	if hum then
		local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if animator then
			local ok, tracks = pcall(function() return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
			if ok and tracks and #tracks > 0 then
				for _, trk in ipairs(tracks) do
					if trk.IsPlaying and trk.Animation then
						table.insert(active, {
							id = trk.Animation.AnimationId,
							name = trk.Animation.Name,
							speed = trk.Speed,
							weight = trk.WeightCurrent,
							timePos = trk.TimePosition,
							looped = trk.Looped,
							priority = trk.Priority.Name
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #active == 0 then
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Animation") and (d.Name:lower():find("idle") or (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name:lower():find("idle"))) then
				table.insert(active, {
					id = d.AnimationId,
					name = d.Name,
					speed = 1,
					weight = 1,
					timePos = 0,
					looped = true,
					priority = "Idle"
				})
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return active
end

local function serializeSelection(sel)
	local set, roots = {}, {}
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do set[o] = true end
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do
		local p, isRoot = o.Parent, true
		while p do if set[p] then isRoot = false; break end; p = p.Parent end
		if isRoot then roots[#roots+1] = o end
	end
	if #roots == 0 then return nil end
	local root, records, index = roots[1], {}, {}

	local activeAnims = captureActiveAnimations(root)

	local function walk(o, pIdx)
		local c = CLASS_CONV[o.ClassName] or o.ClassName
		if SKIP_CLASSES[c] then return end

		local isScript = (c == "Script" or c == "LocalScript" or c == "ModuleScript")
		local isMP = (c == "MeshPart") or (pcall(function() return o:IsA("MeshPart") end) and o:IsA("MeshPart"))
		local mId = nil
		if isMP then
			c = "MeshPart"
			mId = readMeshId(o)
		end

		local rec = {c = c, n = o.Name, p = pIdx, props = {}, refs = {}}
		records[#records+1] = rec
		local myIdx = #records
		index[o] = myIdx

		if isMP and mId then rec.mesh = mId end

		for _, k in ipairs(propListFor(c)) do
			local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
			if ok and v ~= nil then
				if typeof(v) == "Instance" then
					if ref_prup[k] then rec.refs[k] = v end
				else
					local ev = emitVal(v)
					if ev then rec.props[k] = ev end
				end
			end
		end

		if isScript then
			local okS, src = pcall(function() return o.Source end)
			if okS and src then rec.props["Source"] = ("%q"):format(src) end
		end

		local okA, attrs = pcall(function() return o:GetAttributes() end)
		if okA and type(attrs) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
				local ev = emitVal(v)
				if ev then rec.attrs = rec.attrs or {}; rec.attrs[k] = ev end
			end
		end

		if c == "Animation" and o.AnimationId and o.AnimationId ~= "" then
			pcall(function()
				local kfs = KeyframeSequenceProvider:GetKeyframeSequenceAsync(o.AnimationId)
				if kfs and kfs:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
					walk(kfs, myIdx)
				end
			end)
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do walk(child, myIdx) end
	end

	walk(root, 0)

	for o, i in pairs(index) do
		for k, target in pairs(records[i].refs) do records[i].refs[k] = index[target] end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		for k in pairs(r.refs) do if type(r.refs[k]) ~= "number" then r.refs[k] = nil end end
		if next(r.refs) == nil then r.refs = nil end
		if next(r.props) == nil then r.props = nil end
	end
	return records, root.Name, #records, activeAnims
end

local function generateCode(name, records, anchorMode, playAnims, activeAnims)
	local animLines = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(activeAnims) do
		animLines[#animLines + 1] = ('\t{ id = %q, name = %q, speed = %s, weight = %s, timePos = %s, looped = %s, priority = %q },'):format(
			a.id, a.name, num(a.speed), num(a.weight), num(a.timePos), tostring(a.looped), a.priority
		)
	end

	local lines = {
		"local CONFIG = {",
		('\tNAME            = %q,'):format(name),
		"\tOFFSET          = CFrame.new(0, 0, -6),",
		('\tANCHOR_MODE     = %q,'):format(anchorMode),
		('\tPLAY_ANIMATIONS = %s,'):format(tostring(playAnims)),
		"\tREPLACE         = true,",
		"}",
		"",
		"local ACTIVE_ANIMS = {",
		table.concat(animLines, "\n"),
		"}",
		"",
		"local DATA = {"
	}

	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		local p = {('c=%q'):format(r.c), ('n=%q'):format(r.n), ('p=%d'):format(r.p)}
		if r.mesh then p[#p+1] = ('mesh=%q'):format(r.mesh) end
		if r.props then
			local pl = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.props) do pl[#pl+1] = ("%s=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(pl)
			p[#p+1] = "props={" .. table.concat(pl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.refs then
			local rl = {}
			for k, idx in pairs(r.refs) do rl[#rl+1] = ("%s=%d"):format(k, idx) end
			table.sort(rl)
			p[#p+1] = "refs={" .. table.concat(rl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.attrs then
			local al = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.attrs) do al[#al+1] = ("[%q]=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(al)
			p[#p+1] = "attrs={" .. table.concat(al, ",") .. "}"
		end
		lines[#lines+1] = "\t{ " .. table.concat(p, ", ") .. " },"
	end
	lines[#lines+1] = "}\n"
	return table.concat(lines, "\n") .. RUNTIME
end

		end)

local function Create(instance, parent, props)
  local new = Instance.new(instance)
  if props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      new[prop] = value
    end
  end
  new.Parent = parent
  return new
end

local function SetProps(instance, props)
  if instance and props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      instance[prop] = value
    end
  end
  return instance
end

local function Corner(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UICorner", parent)
  new.CornerRadius = Configs_HUB.Corner_Radius
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function Stroke(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UIStroke", parent)
  new.Color = Configs_HUB.Cor_Stroke
  new.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  new.Thickness = 2
  
  local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
  }
  gradient.Rotation = 0
  gradient.Parent = new
  
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    while new.Parent do
      gradient.Rotation = (gradient.Rotation + 2) % 360
      RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end
  end)()
  
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function BindClick(button, callback)

local function CreateTween(instance, prop, value, time, tweenWait)
  local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {[prop] = value})
  tween:Play()
  if tweenWait then tween.Completed:Wait() end
end

local function MakeDraggable(gui)
  local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
  gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPos = gui.Position

      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
      end)
    end
  end)

  gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)

  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
  end)
end

local function GetPlayerByString(str)
    if not str or str == "" then return nil end
    str = str:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
    
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = plr.Name:lower()
        local displayName = plr.DisplayName:lower()
        if string.find(name, str, 1, true) or string.find(displayName, str, 1, true) then
            return plr
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Freecam Script for Roblox (Persistent Executor Version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Variables to keep track of current character state
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

local freecamEnabled = false
local speed = 240 -- Camera movement speed
local sensitivity = 0.6 -- Mouse sensitivity

-- Store original settings
local originalWalkSpeed = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16
local originalJumpPower = humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or 50

-- Camera rotation variables
local rotationX = 0
local rotationY = 0

-- Movement keys
local keys = {
    W = false,
    A = false,
    S = false,
    D = false,
    Q = false, -- Down
    E = false, -- Up
    LeftShift = false -- Speed boost
}

-- Function to safely reset camera
local function resetCameraToDefault()
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    
    local currentHumanoid = character or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    if currentHumanoid then
        Camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
    end
    
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    
    if character and character.Parent then
        local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = false end
        if currentHumanoidObj then
            currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16
            currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = originalJumpPower or 50
        end
    end
    
    for key, _ in pairs(keys) do
        keys[key] = false
    end
    
    freecamEnabled = false
end

-- Function to enable freecam
local function enableFreecam()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    
    freecamEnabled = true
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    
    local x, y, z = Camera.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    rotationX = x
    rotationY = y
    
    local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = true end
    if currentHumanoidObj then
        currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = 0
        currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = 0
    end
end

-- Track key presses
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        if freecamEnabled then
            resetCameraToDefault()
        else
            enableFreecam()
        end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R and input:IsModifierKeyDown(Enum.ModifierKey.Ctrl) then
        resetCameraToDefault()
        print("Emergency camera reset activated!")
    end
    
    if freecamEnabled and keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = false
    end
end)

-- Mouse movement for camera rotation
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Delta
        rotationY = rotationY - delta.X * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = rotationX - delta.Y * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = math.clamp(rotationX, -math.pi/2 + 0.01, math.pi/2 - 0.01)
    end
end)

-- Update camera position
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    end
    
    local movementSpeed = speed
    if keys.LeftShift then
        movementSpeed = speed * 2
    end
    
    local cameraRotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rotationX, rotationY, 0)
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if keys.W then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1)).Position end
    if keys.S then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)).Position end
    if keys.A then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(-1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.D then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.E then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if keys.Q then moveVector = moveVector - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    
    if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
    end
    
    local newPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position + moveVector * movementSpeed * deltaTime
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPosition) * cameraRotation
end)

-- CRITICAL FIX: Automatically update variables when you respawn, without breaking the script loops
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    freecamEnabled = false
    character = newCharacter
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    
    if humanoid then
        originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
    end
end)
